articles.title: Enterprise-grade PostgreSQL with AlloyDB Omni RPM Orchestrator is generally available
articles.summary: AlloyDB Omni RPM orchestrator brings production-ready security, resiliency, and low-downtime operations to PostgreSQL workloads.
articles.detail: This GA milestone builds on the foundation laid during our preview release and launches alongside AlloyDB Omni version 18.3.0 to bring cloud-like database automation capabilities to enterprise environments.

articles.title: Google is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Enterprise AI Assistants
articles.summary: Gartner has named Google a Leader in its inaugural 2026 Magic Quadrant for Enterprise AI Assistants.
articles.detail: In this comprehensive evaluation of top enterprise AI assistant vendors, Gartner placed Google in the Leaders quadrant for its evaluation across both Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: User-bound user delegation SAS for Azure Storage
articles.summary: Announcing the addition of enhanced secure authentication in Azure Storage that combines the flexibility of user-delegation shared access signature (SAS) with the user-bound access of Entra ID.
articles.detail: User-bound user delegation SAS is now generally available for new virtual machines and Virtual Machine Scale Sets.

articles.title: Meta Rises 6% as Muse AI Agent Arrives With Paid Subscription Tiers; Alphabet Falls 2%
articles.summary: Meta just attached a price tag to its AI ambitions, and traders are now asking whether a consumer subscription can justify one of the biggest capital budgets in tech history.
articles.detail: Oracle has shed a third of its value while booking a backlog that no software company has ever matched, and the reason that gap exists is exactly what divides investors on the future of enterprise AI adoption.

articles.title: NVIDIA Brings Real-Time AI to Broadcast, Sports and Global Streaming at IBC
articles.summary: At the IBC conference, NVIDIA is showcasing its real-time AI capabilities for broadcast, sports, and global streaming.
articles.detail: More than 44,000 attendees from 170+ countries are gathering to explore 1,300+ exhibitions in 14+ halls and outdoor spaces, with over 600 speakers sharing their expertise on the future of media and entertainment.

articles.title: d-Matrix Adopts NVIDIA NVLink Fusion for Rack-Scale XPU Deployment
articles.summary: AI inference chipmaker d-Matrix will use NVIDIA NVLink Fusion to connect its next-generation Raptor XPUs to NVIDIA’s AI infrastructure platform.
articles.detail: By connecting Raptor to NVIDIA NVLink scale-up and Spectrum-X scale-out networking, the NVIDIA MGX rack architecture and the broader NVIDIA AI platform, NVLink Fusion enables a new class of AI workloads.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Ephemeral OS Disk with full caching for VM/VMSS
articles.summary: Azure Ephemeral OS Disk with full caching is now generally available for new virtual machines and Virtual Machine Scale Sets.
articles.detail: The capability caches the complete OS image on a VM’s local storage, eliminating remote-storage reads after caching finishes.

articles.title: Will Direct TPU Sales Re-Rate Google Stock?
articles.summary: Quietly, a merchant silicon business is emerging inside the world’s largest advertising platform.
articles.detail: The company has now started delivering its custom TPU systems directly to customers, potentially re-rating its stock price.

articles.title: Broadcom’s AI revenue is set to double again next year, and the numbers are staggering
articles.summary: Broadcom's AI revenue surge highlights a transformative shift in the semiconductor industry.
articles.detail: The company has shed light on its AI revenue growth, driving significant upstream investments and competition.

articles.title: Oracle Is The Disruptive Cloud Wildcard: Do You Buy It?
articles.summary: Oracle has shed a third of its value while booking a backlog that no software company has ever matched.
articles.detail: The reason that gap exists is exactly what divides investors on the future of enterprise AI adoption, and whether Oracle can disrupt the cloud market with its AI-powered solutions.

articles.title: Airtel delivered its flawless Indian Premiere League 2026 cricket broadcasts
articles.summary: For the millions of fervent fans of the Indian Premiere League, being able to count on a flawless live streaming cricket experience is never up for debate.
articles.detail: During the IPL 2026 season, Airtel partnered with Google Cloud to manage this diabolical traffic, eliminating dropped packets and buffering from the equation.

articles.title: Secure team file sharing on Amazon WorkSpaces with Amazon EFS
articles.summary: As more organizations move to remote and distributed work, builders and development teams face growing challenges in sharing files securely.
articles.detail: Central IT becomes a bottleneck when handling every permission change, yet granting full access permissions poses significant security risks from scattered storage locations.

articles.title: Two zones or three? A design framework for zone-resilient Azure workloads
articles.summary: Zone resiliency isn’t a single number you apply to a whole workload.
articles.detail: Decide zone patterns component by component, use service-managed zone redundancy wherever it fits, and reserve three-zone designs for the components that genuinely require a third failure domain.

articles.title: Beyond the benchmark: How an adaptive approach drives scientific discovery
articles.summary: For research and development (R&D) organizations, the promise of agentic AI is not a better one-time answer.
articles.detail: It is a new way to explore complex scientific and engineering problems: pursuing multiple hypotheses, validating them against evidence, learning from what does not work, and adapting their approach as new information becomes available.

articles.title: Boots on the Ground: ‘WARDOGS’ Goes All Out on GeForce NOW at Early-Access Launch
articles.summary: Gear up: The latest PC games and major updates are ready to play on GeForce NOW this week.
articles.detail: WARDOGS drops onto the cloud at early-access launch, alongside the Valheim 1.0 Deep North update and Bus Simulator 27 — part of nine new titles joining the cloud.
